description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeePictureDao class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing saving and retrieving employee picture data.

classes.name: EmployeePictureDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for EmployeePictureDao, testing CRUD operations related to employee pictures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, setting up the EmployeePictureDao instance and loading fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeePicture entity and verifies all fields are correctly persisted and updated.

methods.name: testGetEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee pictures by employee number, including cases with existing and non-existing records.
